scheme_name: Cash Incentive to Wards of ESM (Academic Scholarship)
other_conditions: Applicant must be a ward of an ESM or a ward of the widow of an ESM
Applicant must be registered with the Department of Sainik Welfare, Puducherry
Applicant must have scored at least 95% in Class 11th/12th
Applicant must have scored at least 90% in the semester/annual exam of a non‑professional course (or 80% for a professional course)
Applicant must not be receiving any other academic scholarship
